QuestInfo.name: [Operation: Dive] Russellon of the Alcadnos
QuestInfo.0: You and Melin agree to split up and investigate the Life Core's whereabouts separately. Head to the Alcadno Society and make use of Keeny's introduction to speak with Russellon.
QuestInfo.1: You and Melin agree to split up and investigate the Life Core's whereabouts separately. Head to the Alcadno Society and make use of Keeny's introduction to speak with Russellon.
QuestInfo.2: Russellon told an interesting story. Upon returning and speaking about the Life Core with Yulete, he left to speak with an alchemist named Bedin. You'll have to wait for him to return.
